Resolves #21930

The Resource Timeline opens at its first booking on the current UTC day. The same plain grid renders a timeline column, and the catalog now lists it under Grid & Table and Scheduler.

Evidence: L3 headless Chromium at desktop and phone sizes → L3 required.

CI jobs: +0.

Merge order. First [#22000, the shared header correction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22000), then [Pages #185](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/185) with the corrected cover pair, then this example.

## Deltas from ticket

Included the Neo Light cover partner. The caption takes only its own height and the narrower resource column gives the time column more room at phone width.

## Test Evidence

The five existing `timeline/Basic.spec.mjs` cases passed on all supported themes. The new catalog card also exposed two older test assumptions. The capture unit test now verifies scripted recipes and landing frames according to their source, and the Portal E2E scrolls to the named Table card. All 28 capture cases and all eight affected Portal cases passed locally. `git diff --check` and the Engine commit hooks passed.
